records.subject: You're in -- let's get River Media set up
records.body:
Hi Kai,

Welcome! Wrenfield works best once there's a real project in it, so that's the one thing I'd suggest doing first. Inviting your team comes next -- tasks are a lot more useful once more than one person is on them.

Reply any time.

Best,
Nadia Goldberg

records.text: New signup alert -- *River Media* just created a workspace on pro.

decisions.rationale: Account is engaged early: first_project reached day 2 and 1 invite sent, no tickets or complaints. But key_milestone still unreached after 6 days and no customer reply to onboarding email [email:e1058f71]; silence after initial burst suggests moderate, not high, odds within the 8 remaining days.

draft.subject: One next step for River Media
draft.body:
Hi Kai,

Nice work getting River Media's first project into Wrenfield, and sending that first invite. Projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so adding a few real tasks to that project is usually what makes it click for a team.

If it's easier, I'm happy to jump on a short call this week and walk through that first set of tasks with you -- just tell me a time that works and I'll make it happen.

Best,
Nadia
